notes.title: Halloween update and HUGE price drop!
notes.content:
To celebrate this coming Halloween, we bring you several updates and a massive price drop!

- 46% off! Lazaretto now only $6.99!
- Replaced hospital with new, original assets
- New poster puzzle (original art by Terry Montimore)
- Fixed camera sensitivity on alternate views (ladder, boat, slide, etc)
- Tweaked gameplay, enemies, audio and notes
- Added values to FOV slider
- Fixed player jump bug
- Added VSync option
